scope: Offline Python design check of authored axis-aligned collision boxes and static setup source. This does not execute Luau, Roblox Studio, physics, or a character controller.

test_player.body_collision_rule: Strict positive-volume intersection above feet + 0.2 studs. Touching boundaries alone are not overlaps.
test_player.support_rule: Entire 2.2x2.2 footprint must be inside one authored collider top at Y=1.62 at every sample.

method: Sample each straight centerline every 0.25 studs inclusive, then independently intersect the continuous swept player AABB against every collider in the body height interval. Exact for these axis-aligned, straight, fixed-height test paths. Floor support is checked at each sample.
intentional_exclusions: Paths stop at Z=-39 before altar steps; stair ascent and altar access are not tested.
Entrance path starts at Z=57 inside the entrance approach; exterior stairs and full entrance approach are not tested.
No cross-aisle, between-pew, tower, exterior, jumping, moving-character, multiplayer, or device performance checks.
Checks use setup-data box geometry, not Studio-imported assets or generated physics.

checks_before_mutation: Valid dimensions and finite collider/light metadata
Only owned setup folder can be replaced; foreign contents cause refusal
All visuals are MeshParts with Vesper prefix and required cathedral markers
PrimaryPart is not inside replaceable setup
Visual aspect ratios within 3 percent before normalization
setup_source_review.scaling: Model:ScaleTo(currentScale * authoredWidth / measuredVisualWidth); exact saved pivot restored; visual bounds exclude previous setup. Collider positions map authored center into normalized visual bounds in pivot orientation.
setup_source_review.undo_and_failure: TryBeginRecording required before modifications; previous owned setup detached within recording; failures restore scale/pivot/visual properties/setup or retain an Undo step if restoration fails.
